_: Trait vocabulary the collection ships: every value contracts/test/fixtures/traits.csv may hold, as read from the finished art. encode-traits.mjs refuses a table with any value not listed here. It is not the generator's vocabulary: scripts/characters/glamtoon_traits.py also writes labels that are not here, such as Hair Value, finer age bands and named cuts. Hair Colour keeps None as the value a character with no hair carries; the contract does not emit an attribute whose value is None. Bit widths carry headroom and the record is exactly 16 bits. Regenerate the sources after any change: node scripts/characters/encode-traits.mjs
